description_en: Proactively deactivates a single card that is in the "In Use" state
description_zh: 将状态为“使用中”的单卡进行自主停用
name: StopSingleCard

parameters.help_en:
The ICCID of the IoT card.

You can view the ICCID on the IoT card, or on the Card Management page of the [IoT SIM Service console](https://dyiotnext.console.aliyun.com/?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.6a072d25p4pUg8)
parameters.help_zh:
物联网卡的ICCID。

您可在物联网卡上查看ICCID，或者在[物联网SIM服务控制台](https://dyiotnext.console.aliyun.com/?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.6a072d25p4pUg8)的卡管理页面，查看ICCID
parameters.name: iccid

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform the operation on a sub-card. Set this parameter to the MSISDN of the sub-card.

- This parameter is not required for a standard single-network card.
- For a virtual network operator:
    - If you specify this parameter, the operation is performed on the specified sub-card.
    - If you do not specify this parameter, the operation is performed on all sub-cards
parameters.help_zh:
是否对子卡进行操作，填入子卡的MSISDN。

- 普通单网卡无需传入此参数。
- 虚拟运营商：
    - 如果传入该参数，则对指定的子卡进行操作。
    - 如果不传入该参数，则对所有子卡进行操作
parameters.name: opt_msisdns
